title: Global Investor Programme PR numbers and investments from 2015 to 2025
asked: Mr Fadli Fawzi asked how many people received permanent residency under the Global Investor Programme from 2015 to 2025, broken down by investment option, and the cumulative investment made by these PRs by industry sector and GIP-select fund.
response: Ms Gan Siow Huang said around 450 individuals were granted PR through the GIP from 2015 to 2025, with about 50% using the $10 million business entity option, 40% the $25 million GIP-select fund option, and 10% the Single Family Office option. About $500 million was invested directly in Singapore-based business entities, more than half in Professional Services, Info-Communications and Financial Services, and another $430 million was placed in GIP funds investing in Singapore-based companies.

key_points.point: The GIP grants PR status to eligible global investors who make significant investments to drive business growth in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: the Global Investor Programme (GIP) accords Permanent Resident (PR) status to eligible global investors who make significant investments to drive business growth in Singapore.

key_points.point: One investment option is at least $10 million in a new or existing Singapore-based business entity.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: invest at least $10 million in a new or existing Singapore-based business entity

key_points.point: Another option is at least $25 million in a GIP-select fund that invests in Singapore-based companies.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: invest at least $25 million in a GIP-select fund that invests in Singapore-based companies

key_points.point: A third option is a Singapore-based Single Family Office with at least $200 million in Assets-Under-Management.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: establish a Singapore-based Single Family Office with at least $200 million in Assets-Under-Management

key_points.point: From 2015 to 2025, around 450 individuals were accorded permanent residency through the GIP.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: From 2015 to 2025, around 450 individuals were accorded permanent residency through the GIP.

key_points.point: The distribution across the three options is approximately 50%, 40% and 10% respectively.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: The distribution across options (a), (b) and (c) is approximately 50%, 40% and 10% respectively.

key_points.point: About $500 million was invested directly in new or existing Singapore-based business entities.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: about $500 million was invested directly in new or existing Singapore-based business entities

key_points.point: More than half of these direct investments were in Professional Services, Info-Communications and Financial Services sub-sectors.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: More than half of these investments were in the Professional Services, Info-Communications and Financial Services sub-sectors.

key_points.point: Another $430 million was placed in GIP funds that invest in Singapore-based companies.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: Another $430 million was placed in GIP funds that invest in Singapore-based companies.

key_points.point: The Minister said she did not have figures on the number or proportion of GIP PRs who applied for Singapore citizenship, nor data on retention of these investors as PRs.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: I do not have on hand the figures on the number of PRs, or the proportion of PRs under the GIP scheme who subsequently applied for Singapore Citizenship, nor do I have the data on the retention of these investors as PRs.

key_points.point: EDB works with GIP recipients to ensure they continue to fulfil specified economic and residency commitments during their stay.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: EDB works with the GIP recipients to ensure that they continue to fulfil the Government's specified economic and residency commitments during their stay.

key_points.point: GIP PRs must submit evidence of the Singapore-based companies they have invested in.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: GIP PRs are required to submit evidence of the Singapore-based companies that they have invested in.

key_points.point: EDB conducts visits to these companies to assess their business activities.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: EDB will also conduct visits to these companies to assess the company's business activities.

key_points.point: Only GIP PRs who meet both economic and residency commitments will have their re-entry permit renewed for a further five-year period.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: Only GIP PRs who meet both economic and residency commitments under GIP will subsequently have their so-called re-entry permit renewed for a further five-year period.

key_points.point: Since the scheme was reviewed recently, no major change in applicant profile has been seen yet.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: since the scheme has been reviewed quite recently, we are not seeing a major change in the profile yet.

key_points.point: Before 2023, GIP funds were mainly local funds, and select funds were introduced subsequently.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: prior to 2023, the GIP funds comprised mainly of local funds, and also the select funds were subsequently introduced.

key_points.point: Applicants who chose to invest under GIP select funds are still going through the application process and have yet to confirm their investments.
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: The applicants who have selected to invest under the GIP select funds are still going through the application process and have yet to confirm on their investments.
